scenarios.name: Building cupboards don't know what to buy
scenarios.last_reply:
Our 16mm White Melamine Chipboard is the best starting choice for cupboard carcasses and shelving because it's strong, easy to maintain, and provides great value.

To get started on your cupboards, 5 sheets of White Melamine Chipboard will give you plenty of material for your internal carcass and shelving.

Shall I go ahead and process this order for you so we can get your project underway?

scenarios.name: What boards for kitchen cabinets
scenarios.last_reply:
For kitchen cabinets, we recommend **16mm White Melamine Chipboard**—it's the top choice across all our branches because it's durable, easy to clean, and cost-effective. For the doors, you can either stick with classic white melamine or choose a decorative wood grain finish.

If you have rough measurements or a photo of your kitchen space, send it through and I'd be happy to help figure out how many boards you need!

scenarios.name: Renovating kitchen where to start
scenarios.last_reply:
Love that you're taking on this project! We manufacture quality boards with precision cutting across our 32 branches nationwide, so you're in great hands.

To get started, what kind of look or colour are you picturing for your cabinets?

scenarios.name: Help me choose materials
scenarios.last_reply:
Let's keep it simple! Here is what we usually recommend based on what you're making:

- **Cabinets & Shelving:** White Melamine Chipboard 16mm (great quality and best value).
- **Cabinet Doors & Visible Panels:** Innowood Wood Grain (like Dakota Oak) or Chrometree Gloss.
- **Tops:** HDS FX Dura Postform Counter Tops (just sent some options above).

Which of these are you looking to get started with?

scenarios.name: Prices probably too expensive
scenarios.last_reply:
I completely understand that price is a big consideration. Because we manufacture our own boards in our own factories, we cut out the middleman to give you unbeatable value and competitive pricing without compromising on quality. 

What kind of project are you working on, and shall I prepare a quick quote for you to compare?

scenarios.name: Usually buy from Builders
scenarios.last_reply:
I completely understand wanting to stick with Builders since they're familiar. 

The biggest advantage with HDS is that we manufacture our own White Melamine Chipboard boards in our own factories. That means you get superior Innowood quality, precision cutting, and heat-bonded edges at competitive, factory-direct prices (often 20–30% better value) without retail markups.

Shall I put together a quote for your project so you can compare the value directly?
